finalText:
**1,291 matches across 94 files. Only the `services/**` tree is safe to rename.**

| Area | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS names | 1,200 | Yes, mechanical |
| SQL strings in `services/**/repo` | 125 of those | Only with a new migration |
| [migrations/*.sql](migrations/20250624_backfill_account_ids.sql:9) | 61 | No, applied history |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js:3) | 20 | No, regenerated |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | 5 | No, frozen public field |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) wire value | 1 | No, breaks clients |

The 125 SQL strings name a real DB column.

25 repos also write `account_id` into the JSONB `payload`. Old rows keep the old key.

Next: sign off scoped to `services/**` names only.
